notes.title: Update fix for Dark Parables: The Exiled Prince Collector's Edition
notes.content:
Thank you for reporting the CE content missing from this game. We've updated the game with the CE contents, and you should see this right away. If not, please try restarting the Steam Client. 

However, you'll need to rename the saved folder to get your progress in the game back. Here's how you can do that:

- First, make sure you've selected "Show Hidden Files, Folders, and Drives" in the Folder Option. To do that, just type Folder Options in the Windows Search Bar, and launch it.

- Navigate to the following location:
C:\Users\"YOUR USERNAME"\AppData\Roaming\Blue Tea Games\Dark Parables The Exiled Prince

- Rename the SE folder to CE. The game will register your progress when you launch it.

notes.title: Update fix for Dark Parables: The Exiled Prince Collector's Edition
notes.content:
We've received reports about the missing piece in the Elegant Crank Hidden Object Scene, and have uploaded a fix for this issue. Please restart the Steam client for an automatic update or try starting a new profile or reinstall the game. 

Thank you everyone for your feedback!
